notes: I love it. Some friends love it. Some friends hate it. If you can get over the grape, it's a great pick
body:
This one is hard for me to keep objective. I rate it highly because if it fits into your taste bucket, it's solid. It has the grape cough syrup taste, so if you can get around it, it's fine.

Overall taste: if you mixed all colored skittles + grape juice into your mouth with some extra carbonation. The taste hits you right away. You taste the rainbow right away, and the first time you try it I promise your eyes will light up. For most of you in a good way. If chilled, it's very refeshing, great mix of sour and sweet, and the sour nor sweet does not linger in your mouth. Taste wise I'd say it's an 8.

What boosted this is the combination of QUICK energy it gives you + not having any dry mouth effect. That's really rare, and I rarely get that. Overall, if you can handle the grape, try it out. It's not my alani staple but I always come back to it.
name: Cosmic Stardust
